verdict.rationale: Cua documents an audit log on its shared Cua Volume (cua-docs-25), and a community user credits Cua-Bench with trajectory export (cua-comm-9), so after-the-fact records exist in some form. Most of the documented observability is live, though: watching, streaming and following agents in real time (cua-docs-11, cua-docs-23), not reviewing runs afterwards. Missing for 10: documented per-run replay of steps taken, recorded screens/screenshots, logs of injected inputs, a description of what the audit log captures, and trajectory capture outside the Bench context.
